text:
ryan: Rolling v3.2.0 -> eu-west-2 (canary). Starting end-to-end smoke which includes: tokenization checks, kv-prefill warmup, and a short synthetic user flow that touches session-cache. Will watch for 20m.

deploy-bot: canary shift to 1% applied. readiness/liveness passing. invoking smoke-suite: short+e2e.

claire: Kicking off e2e: `./smoke/e2e --region=eu-west-2 --flow=chat+prefill --repeat=20` 1: deploybot will surface results in this thread.

ops-bot: short-suite interim: 10/10 quick checks OK, p50=38ms p95=95ms. No immediate tokenization diffs.

simon: Observing ramp-side warmup lag: session-cache hit-rate on canary hosts is 68% vs baseline 94%. Queueing on kv-prefill writer increased ~3.5x at 12:13:02 UTC. Sample logs:```
12:12:58 kv-prefill-canary pod=kv-7 enqueued=18 qdepth=2
12:13:02 kv-prefill-canary pod=kv-7 enqueued=72 qdepth=9
12:13:05 session-cache-canary pod=sc-4 hit=false key="u:1234:sess"
```

ryan: Not ideal. If session-cache hit-rate stays low we can get cookie-drop errors in the e2e flow. Proposal: pause global ramp and pin session-backed routes (chat/session) in eu-west-2 to v3.1.x while we triage. Keep canary at 1% for 30m. Thresholds: if session-cache hit-rate >= 90% and kv qdepth < 2x baseline for 10m -> resume to 20%. If session-cache hit-rate <= 70% for 5m OR any 5xx from session service -> rollback to v3.1.9. Add release note stub about warmup variance.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by ryan. pin set: eu-west-2 session-routes -> v3.1.9 at 1% until 3623458649.

claire: I'm running extended e2e now to surface any functional regressions (repeat=100, sampling variety). ETA ~14m. Posting failures as they come.

ops-bot: created alert rule: `alert:session_cache.hit_rate < 0.80 for 5m` -> notify #oncall and page if duration > 10m.

simon: Quick mitigation: temporarily reduce prefill concurrency on canary hosts to avoid writer spikes: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-prefill PREFILL_CONCURRENCY=3 -n eu-west-2-canary` 1: applying now. Also enabling extra session-cache prefetch on canary: `kubectl set env deploy/session-cache PREFETCH=true -n eu-west-2-canary`.

ops-bot: mitigation applied. Monitoring telemetry.

claire: Early e2e results: 8/100 flows failed, main symptom: session resurrection mismatch (session token missing on rehydrate). Sample flow log:```
flow=chat-1 id=flow-9 step=rehydrate token=null expected=token-abc error=ERR_SESSION_MISSING
```

ryan: Those failures match the low hit-rate. Owners: simon (mitigation & nodepool config), claire (flow repros + logs), ops-bot (alerts). Decision: hold canary at 1% for 30m. If mitigation raises hit-rate above 90% and e2e failure rate <0.2% -> schedule staged ramp tomorrow in 08:00 UTC window. If failure rate >0.5% persist for 5m -> rollback. Release note: "v3.2.0: adjusted session-cache warmup; pinned session routes in eu-west-2 pending validation."

deploy-bot: note: rollout paused by ryan. pin applied.

alert-bot: Alert: session_cache.hit_rate dropped to 0.69 at 12:14:10 UTC (eu-west-2 canary). Notifying #oncall.

claire: I'll continue extended runs with a narrower sampling of session-heavy interactions to validate the prefetch patch. Posting periodic summaries.

simon: I'll also watche the nodepool and increase idle prefetch if needed. If we see memory climb, we'll revert prefetch and consider a patch release with a deterministic warmup sequence.

ryan: Thanks team. Action items: 1) simon -> confirm effects of PREFETCH and PREFILL_CONCURRENCY in 10m, 2) claire -> post e2e failure log summary, 3) ops-bot -> hold pager thresholds and update dashboard note. Reconvene in 15m or on any threshold breach.
